$comment: 语法大厅 G14（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：昨晚八点，我们正在演。与 KET 八课 L4 共用进行时「两件套 be + -ing」说法（L4 原文：两件套缺一不可；While we were playing, it started to rain），L4 零改动。全部内容原创。
title: 过去进行时
ketNote: KET 直接考得少，但 Part 7 看图写故事里一句 was/were + -ing 能把画面感写出来，是加分句型。八课里的亲戚是 L4。

sections.essence: 昨晚八点，我们正在演：was/were + -ing，给过去某一刻的画面配说明。
sections.why: 中文说「昨晚八点我们正在演出」，只要把「正在」和时间词摆在一起就行，「演」字纹丝不动。英语的「正在」是两件套：be + 动词-ing，缺一不可——这是 G07 就认识的老朋友。要把镜头摇回昨天，英语不新发明一套衣服，只做一个动作：给两件套里的 be 盖上过去戳——am/is 变 was，are 变 were，-ing 原样不动。所以过去进行时不是新语法，是「进行时两件套」和「过去戳」两位老朋友的合作：was/were 报告「这是过去的事」，-ing 报告「当时画面正在进行」。中国孩子最容易只记 -ing 忘了换 was/were，或干脆用一般过去时——那样「当时正在做」就变成「做完了」，画面感全没了。
sections.metaphorStory: 昨晚八点，银帆乐团正演到第二首曲子。团里的摄影师悄悄按了一下快门。今天老师把照片贴在排练室门口问大家：「昨晚八点，你们正在干什么？」照片会说话：We were playing the second song. 小提琴手说 I was playing the violin，两个鼓手说 We were drumming。给这张「旧照片」配说明文字，用的还是进行时那副两件套——be + -ing，一件都不能少；只是照片是昨天的，所以 be 要换成过去的模样：was 或 were。还有一张更有意思的照片：演出中途灯忽然灭了一秒。说明文字这样写——While we were playing, the lights went out. 长长的演奏是背景，用 was/were + -ing 铺开；「灯灭」是咔嚓一声的快门，用一般过去时插进来。一长一短，一背景一快门，过去的故事立刻有了画面。

cards.detail: 进行时永远是 be + -ing 两件套，缺一不可；讲过去就把 be 换过去形——I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。
cards.example: I was reading. / They were singing.

cards.rule: 什么时候用：过去某一刻，正在做
cards.detail: 信号词是「过去的时间点」：yesterday at eight / at that time / then / when + 一般过去时的小句。
cards.example: At nine last night, I was taking a shower.

cards.rule: 长镜头 + 快门：was doing... when did
cards.detail: 长时间铺开的背景动作用过去进行；中途「咔嚓」插进来的短动作用一般过去。
cards.example: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

cards.detail: while 后面通常跟过去进行（长动作）；when 后面常跟一般过去（短动作）。
cards.example: While we were playing, it started to rain.

cards.detail: 多数直接加 -ing；不发音的 e 去掉再加；短元音+单辅音先双写。
know、like、want、love 这类「状态」不是「动作」，通常不用进行时——过去的状态直接用一般过去。
cards.example: I knew the answer.（不说 I was knowing）

basic.en: I was doing my homework at eight last night.
basic.cn: 昨晚八点我正在写作业。（was + doing 两件套）

basic.en: They were singing in the music room then.
basic.cn: 那时他们正在音乐教室唱歌。

basic.en: She was drawing a picture at that time.
We were having dinner at seven yesterday.
basic.cn: 昨天七点我们正在吃晚饭。

basic.en: The dog was sleeping under the table.
basic.cn: 狗当时正睡在桌子底下。

mid.en: I was sleeping when the phone rang.
mid.cn: 电话响的时候我正在睡觉。（长镜头 + 快门）

mid.en: While Dad was cooking, I was setting the table.
mid.cn: 爸爸做饭的时候，我在摆碗筷。（两个长镜头并排）

mid.en: When I saw her, she was waiting for the bus.
mid.cn: 我看见她时，她正在等公交。

mid.en: It was raining hard when we left the school.
mid.cn: 我们离开学校时，雨正下得很大。

mid.en: What were you doing at nine last night?
mid.cn: 昨晚九点你在干什么？（was/were 提前举手提问）

trap.en: While we were playing, the lights went out.
trap.cn: 我们正演着，灯忽然灭了。
trap.note: 长镜头用 were playing，快门「灯灭」用一般过去 went——别把两个都写成进行时。

trap.en: I was swimming when it began to rain.
trap.cn: 开始下雨时我正在游泳。
trap.note: swim 短元音+单辅音，-ing 要双写 m——swimming。

trap.en: She was making a card for her mum.
trap.cn: 她当时正在给妈妈做贺卡。
trap.note: make 去掉不发音的 e 再加 -ing——making，不是 makeing。

trap.en: I wanted a new bike last year.
trap.cn: 去年我想要一辆新自行车。
trap.note: want 是状态动词，不说 I was wanting——过去的状态用一般过去。

trap.en: Tom and I were watching the stars at ten.
trap.cn: 十点时我和汤姆正在看星星。
trap.note: Tom and I 是「我们」，be 用 were，不用 was。

trap.en: The baby was crying, so I picked her up.
trap.cn: 宝宝当时在哭，所以我把她抱了起来。
trap.note: 「哭」是持续的背景，「抱起」是快门动作——一进行一过去，各盖各的戳。

redBlack.bad: When Mum came in, I cleaned my room.（想说：她进来时我正在打扫）
redBlack.good: When Mum came in, I was cleaning my room.
redBlack.why: cleaned 是「打扫完了」，was cleaning 是「正扫着」——妈妈看到的到底是干净房间还是你拿着扫把，意思完全不同。

redBlack.bad: I watched TV when the doorbell rang.（想说：门铃响时我正看着电视）
redBlack.good: I was watching TV when the doorbell rang.
redBlack.why: 两个一般过去连用像「先看完电视、门铃再响」；要表达「正看着被打断」必须用 was watching。

redBlack.bad: I was do my homework at eight.
redBlack.good: I was doing my homework at eight.
redBlack.why: 两件套缺了 -ing——be + -ing 缺一不可。
they 配 were——was 只跟 I/he/she/it。

redBlack.bad: She were reading a book at that time.
redBlack.good: She was reading a book at that time.
redBlack.why: she 配 was——was/were 要跟主语对上号。

redBlack.bad: I am watching TV at nine last night.
redBlack.good: I was watching TV at nine last night.
redBlack.why: last night 已定过去调，be 却穿着现在的衣服——半路转调。

redBlack.bad: What did you doing when I called?
redBlack.good: What were you doing when I called?
redBlack.why: did 和 -ing 不配套——进行时提问由 was/were 自己提前举手。
know 是状态动词，不上进行时的镜头——过去的状态用 knew。

redBlack.bad: We were swiming in the pool at four.
redBlack.good: We were swimming in the pool at four.
redBlack.why: swim 短元音+单辅音，-ing 要双写 m。

redBlack.bad: While I took a shower, the lights went out.（想说：正洗着澡）
redBlack.good: While I was taking a shower, the lights went out.
redBlack.why: while 领的是长镜头——里面用过去进行，别用一般过去。

redBlack.bad: I was sat by the window when he came.
redBlack.good: I was sitting by the window when he came.
redBlack.why: was sat 是英国部分地区口语，意思不挡；考试和作文里写 was sitting 更稳。

redBlack.bad: At 8:00 yesterday night, we were eating.
redBlack.good: At 8:00 last night, we were eating.
redBlack.why: yesterday night 不地道但意思不挡——地道说法是 last night。

contrast.cn: 昨晚八点我们正在演出。（「演」不变，靠「正在」+时间词）
contrast.en: We were performing at eight last night.（be 盖过去戳 + -ing）
contrast.diff: 中文的「正在」不分今昨；英语的「正在」要跟着时间换衣服——今天 am/is/are，昨天 was/were。

contrast.cn: 我正写着作业，电话响了。（「着」+「了」配合）
contrast.en: I was doing my homework when the phone rang.
contrast.diff: 中文用「着／了」分背景和快门；英语用「过去进行 + 一般过去」分长镜头和短动作。

contrast.cn: 那时候他在等车。（「在」一个字搞定）
contrast.en: He was waiting for the bus at that time.
contrast.diff: 中文的「在」永远一个字；英语要按主语挑 was 还是 were，还得给动词接 -ing 尾巴。

contrast.cn: 我当时很想要那本书。（「想要」照常用）
contrast.en: I wanted that book.（不说 was wanting）
contrast.diff: 中文不区分动作和状态；英语的 know/like/want 是状态动词，不进镜头、不用进行时。

contrast.cn: 你昨晚九点在干嘛？（语序不变，加个「吗／嘛」）
contrast.en: What were you doing at nine last night?（were 提前举手）
contrast.diff: 中文提问靠语气词；英语进行时提问由 was/were 自己走到主语前面。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先定哪一天，再定哪一刻；过去的一刻正在做——was/were 加 -ing。
steps: 找时间：yesterday at... / at that time / then / when+过去小句 → 镜头在过去。
问自己：是「那一刻正在做」的画面，还是「做完了」的结果？画面才用进行。
接 -ing，过一遍拼写三规则（直接加 / 去 e / 双写）。
有「咔嚓」插进来的短动作？它用一般过去，别跟着 -ing。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们玩『昨晚八点』：我说一个昨天的时间，你用英语说那时候你正在做什么，比如 I was reading。我不懂英语没关系，我只当检查员，听两样东西：一有没有 was 或 were，二动词尾巴有没有 -ing——两样凑齐才算『正在』。」孩子说顺了可以升级：你拍一下手当「快门」，让她把刚才那句加上一个突发事件，比如 I was reading when you clapped。听到她说 I was read 或 I doing，就提醒一句「两件套少了一件」。
questions: 英语里说「昨晚正在做」，要用哪两件套？少一件行不行？
was 和 were 怎么分工？They ___ playing 该填哪个？
I was sleeping when the phone rang. 里哪个动作是长镜头，哪个是快门？

sections.echo: -ing 这条尾巴是「二合一」来的：古英语的现在分词本来长 -ende，动名词长 -ung，两条尾巴发音越来越像，几百年里被懒惰的舌头磨成了同一个 -ing——所以今天它既能当「正在」（is singing）又能当名词（singing is fun）。再看 was/were：动词的过去式几乎全都不分单复数了（played 就是 played），唯独最常用的 be 还留着 was/were 两副面孔——又一次印证那条暗线：越常用的词，越不规则。

memoryCard.alt: G14 记忆卡：过去进行时=两件套过去版 was/were+-ing 缺一不可；长镜头（背景动作用过去进行）+快门（突发动作用一般过去）；信号词与 -ing 拼写三规则；警示 was do、They was、was knowing 三类错误。

stages.name: 认一认 · 两件套点名

questions.q: 「过去某一刻正在做」用哪套装备？
questions.explain: 过去的「正在」= 两件套过去版：was/were + -ing。

questions.q: 进行时两件套指的是哪两件？
questions.explain: be + -ing，缺一不可——过去版只是把 be 换成 was/were。

questions.q: I ___ reading at nine last night.
questions.explain: I 配 was；last night 定了过去调。

questions.q: They ___ dancing at that time.
questions.explain: they 配 were。

questions.q: She ___ drawing a cat then.
questions.explain: she 配 was；then＝那时，过去信号。

questions.q: We ___ watching a film at eight yesterday.
questions.explain: we 配 were。

questions.q: at that time（那时）是哪个时态的信号词？
questions.explain: 「那时正在做」→ was/were + -ing。

questions.q: 下面哪个是过去进行时的句子？
questions.explain: was + sleeping——be 盖了过去戳的两件套。

questions.q: make 接 -ing 怎么写？
questions.explain: 不发音的 e 去掉再加 -ing。

questions.q: swim 接 -ing 怎么写？
questions.explain: 短元音+单辅音，先双写 m 再加 -ing。

questions.q: sit 接 -ing 怎么写？
questions.explain: 双写 t——sitting。

questions.q: write 接 -ing 怎么写？
questions.explain: 去 e 加 -ing——writing。

questions.q: 下面哪个词通常不用进行时？
questions.explain: know 是状态动词，不上镜头——不说 was knowing。

questions.q: The cats ___ chasing a ball then.
questions.explain: the cats 是复数 → were。

questions.q: My brother ___ playing chess at four.
questions.explain: my brother = he → was。

questions.q: 过去进行时里，-ing 要不要跟着变过去？
options: 不用，只有 be 换成 was/were
questions.explain: 只给 be 盖过去戳，-ing 原样不动。

stages.name: 选一选 · 配好说明文字

questions.q: At eight last night, I ___ a shower.
questions.explain: 「昨晚八点正在洗」——过去某一刻的画面用 was taking。

questions.q: They ___ basketball when it started to rain.
questions.explain: 长镜头 were playing，快门 started。

questions.q: Look at this photo — we ___ on the beach then.
questions.explain: 照片是过去的画面 → were running。

questions.q: She ___ to music while she was drawing.
questions.explain: 两个长镜头并排：was listening + was drawing。

questions.q: The baby ___ when I opened the door.
questions.explain: 开门那一刻宝宝「正睡着」——was sleeping。

questions.q: What ___ you doing at nine yesterday?
questions.explain: 进行时提问由 were 提前举手，不请 did。

questions.q: Dad ___ dinner when I got home.
questions.explain: 到家时爸爸「正做着饭」——was cooking。

questions.q: While I ___ my bike, I saw a rainbow.
questions.explain: while 领长镜头 → was riding；saw 是快门。

questions.q: At noon yesterday, the birds ___ in the tree.
questions.explain: birds 复数 → were singing。

questions.q: I ___ for the bus when you called me.
questions.explain: 打电话那刻我「正等着」——was waiting。

questions.q: He ___ a kite at four o'clock yesterday.
questions.explain: 昨天四点的画面 → was flying。

questions.q: We ___ hide-and-seek at that time.
questions.explain: we 配 were——were playing。

questions.q: My parents ___ TV when the lights went out.
questions.explain: parents 复数 → were watching；灯灭是快门。

questions.q: The wind ___ hard when we left home.
questions.explain: 出门时风「正刮着」——was blowing。

questions.q: I ___ my teeth at seven this morning.（现在是晚上）
questions.explain: 今早七点已是过去的一刻 → was brushing。

questions.q: Snow ___ when the train arrived.
questions.explain: 火车到站时雪「正下着」——长镜头 was falling。

stages.name: 改一改 · 照片说明纠错

questions.q: 哪句给「昨晚八点」的照片配对了说明？
options: We were eating dinner at eight last night.
We are eating dinner at eight last night.
We was eating dinner at eight last night.
questions.explain: 过去的照片配 were eating——be 必须盖过去戳且跟 we 对上号。

questions.q: 哪句的两件套穿齐了？
options: She was doing her homework then.
She was do her homework then.
questions.explain: was + doing 两件套缺一不可。

questions.q: 哪句的 was/were 挑对了？
options: The twins were sleeping at ten.
The twins was sleeping at ten.
The twins is sleeping at ten.
questions.explain: twins 复数 → were。

questions.q: 哪句没有半路转调？
options: I was reading when Mum came in.
I am reading when Mum came in.
I was reading when Mum comes in.
questions.explain: 整句都在过去调：was reading + came。

questions.q: 哪句的提问举对了手？
options: What were you doing at six?
What did you doing at six?
What you were doing at six?
questions.explain: were 提前到主语前——did 和 -ing 不配套。

questions.q: 哪句把状态动词用对了？
options: I liked the song very much.
I was liking the song very much.
I am liking the song then.
questions.explain: like 是状态动词不上镜头——过去的状态用 liked。

questions.q: 哪句的 -ing 拼写对了？
questions.explain: run 双写 n——running。

questions.q: 哪句的长镜头和快门分工对了？
options: I was taking a bath when the phone rang.
I took a bath when the phone was ringing long.
I was taking a bath when the phone was rang.
questions.explain: 洗澡是背景长镜头 was taking；电话响是快门 rang。

questions.q: 哪句的 while 用对了？
options: While we were playing, it began to snow.
While we played yesterday it snowing.
While we are playing, it began to snow.
questions.explain: while 领长镜头 were playing；began 是快门——全程过去调。

questions.q: 哪句说明文字写对了？（她当时正在浇花）
questions.explain: 两件套齐：was + watering。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我们当时正在爬山）
questions.explain: were + climbing——be 选对、-ing 穿上。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（昨天中午雨正下着）
options: It was raining at noon yesterday.
It was rain at noon yesterday.
It is raining at noon yesterday.
questions.explain: it 配 was + raining；yesterday 定过去调。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（灯灭时他正在写信）
options: He was writing a letter when the lights went out.
He was writting a letter when the lights went out.
He wrote a letter when the lights were going out.
questions.explain: write→writing 去 e 不双写；写信是长镜头，灯灭是快门。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（那时你们正在排队吗）
options: Were you standing in line then?
Was you standing in line then?
Did you standing in line then?
questions.explain: you 配 were，提问时 were 举手到最前。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（当时没人在听）
options: Nobody was listening at that time.
Nobody were listening at that time.
Nobody was listen at that time.
questions.explain: nobody 按单数算 → was listening。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我到时演出正进行着）
options: The show was going on when I arrived.
The show went on when I was arriving.
The show is going on when I arrived.
questions.explain: 演出是长镜头 was going on；「我到」是快门 arrived。

stages.name: 用一用 · 长镜头与快门

questions.q: I ___ a comic when Dad ___ into my room.
questions.explain: 看漫画是长镜头 was reading；爸爸进门是快门 walked。

questions.q: While Mum ___ dishes, I ___ the floor.
questions.explain: 两个动作同时铺开——两个长镜头都用过去进行。

questions.q: They ___ chess when the bell ___.
questions.explain: 下棋是背景，铃声是一瞬间的快门——rang。

questions.q: — What ___ you ___ at 8:30 last night? — I was practising the piano.
questions.explain: 回答用了 was practising，提问自然是 What were you doing。

questions.q: The sun ___ when we ___ the mountain top.
questions.explain: 日出是缓慢的长镜头；「到达山顶」是一下子的快门。

questions.q: I ___ my keys while I ___ in the park.
questions.explain: 「跑步」是长镜头背景；「丢钥匙」一瞬间发生——lost。

questions.q: She usually walks to school, but at 7:30 today she ___ a bus.（现在是下午）
questions.explain: usually 的习惯归习惯；今早 7:30 那一刻已过去 → was catching。

questions.q: When I called him, he ___ — so he didn't hear the phone.
questions.explain: 「没听见电话」说明那刻正睡着——was sleeping。

questions.q: We ___ about the film when the teacher ___ in.
questions.explain: 聊天是背景长镜头；老师进门是快门 came。

questions.q: It ___ heavily, so we ___ at home and played cards.
questions.explain: 雪下着是背景；「决定待在家」是接下来的动作，一般过去 stayed。

questions.q: At this time yesterday, I ___ on a train to Chengdu.
questions.explain: 「昨天的这个时候」是过去的一刻——was sitting。

questions.q: He ___ the answer, so he put up his hand.
questions.explain: know 是状态动词——过去的状态直接 knew，不上镜头。

questions.q: While the band ___, the singer suddenly ___ the stage.
questions.explain: 乐队演奏是长镜头；歌手离场是突发快门 left。

questions.q: — Why didn't you answer the door? — Sorry, I ___ music with my headphones on.
questions.explain: 敲门那会儿「正戴着耳机听歌」——was listening to。

questions.q: The students ___ notes while the teacher ___ the new song.
questions.explain: 记笔记和教歌同时进行——两个长镜头并排铺开。

questions.q: 大考：Yesterday at five, Lily ___ a cake, Ben ___ the room, and I ___ them photos.
options: was making / was cleaning / was taking
questions.explain: 「昨天五点」同一刻三个画面同时进行——三个 was/were + -ing 一次配齐。

detective.sentence: I was watch TV when Mum came home yesterday.
detective.fixed: I was watching TV when Mum came home yesterday.
detective.clue: 两件套缺了一件——was 后面的动词要穿 -ing 尾巴。

detective.sentence: They was singing in the hall at nine last night.
detective.fixed: They were singing in the hall at nine last night.
detective.clue: they 要配 were——was 只跟 I/he/she/it。

detective.sentence: While I was doing my homework, the lights go out.
detective.fixed: While I was doing my homework, the lights went out.
detective.clue: 整句在过去调里，快门动作 go 也要盖过去戳——went。

detective.sentence: She is drawing a horse at that time.
detective.fixed: She was drawing a horse at that time.
detective.clue: at that time 说的是过去，is 却穿着现在的衣服——半路转调。

detective.sentence: What did you doing when I knocked?
detective.fixed: What were you doing when I knocked?
detective.clue: did 和 -ing 不配套——进行时提问由 were 自己举手。

detective.sentence: He was wanting a glass of water after the race.
detective.fixed: He wanted a glass of water after the race.
detective.clue: want 是状态动词，不上进行时的镜头——直接用 wanted。

detective.sentence: We were swiming when the coach blew the whistle.
detective.fixed: We were swimming when the coach blew the whistle.
detective.clue: swim 短元音+单辅音，-ing 要双写 m——blew 没病，别多改。
